coverage.stagingDesktop: Normal Chrome desktop viewport, 2065px observed; additional 1440px support-dialog visual check. Initial desktop viewport override affected the selected production tab; staging dimensions were inspected and mobile testing used an explicit per-tab override.
coverage.recordSampling: At least one representative View per populated table; first and last visible records were sampled on the first 18 staging desktop screens where available. This is screen coverage, not every historical record or pagination page.
coverage.initial18StagingDesktopResults: Passed; retained in browser tool outputs before the controller timeout. These results were not recovered from controller memory.

completedNestedReads.method: Verified completion of the UI-triggered GET through response and loading-finished events before inspecting the resulting dialog. Earlier immediate checks could inspect the previous record; the completed-response checks supersede them. No business mutation was replayed.

emptyDataLimits: Payout export details have no proposals in either environment.
Production mailing-order and provider details have no orders.
Other empty tables were checked for their empty-state presentation; no populated-record claim is made for them.
No customer or fictional records were created to populate an empty view.

dataPreservation.consumerBoundary: Account/session collection hashes differ across the owner-completed normal authentication and admin-read window. Native sign-in updates MFA anti-replay counters. All other Consumer collections, including case/report/packet/billing records, match. These account/session differences are qualified rather than excluded from an equality claim.
dataPreservation.mailRuntimeChanged: Single-row runtime table with columns name and heartbeat_at; normal worker activity is qualified separately.
dataPreservation.accountAndSessionCountDetail: preservation.json contains unchanged account counts in both environments, unchanged staging session count, and the production session created during the owner-completed sign-in. Account collection bytes remain qualified; no exact per-account-field comparison is claimed.

publicationScope: Sanitized report and preservation summary only. No credentials, MFA material, raw customer records, screenshots, protected configuration, backups, or operational scripts are published. Publication is Git-only and does not repeat testing or deploy a new package.
